prompt: Original character concept art for a stylized cel-shaded comic-book brawler video game. Bold clean black ink outlines, two-tone cel shading with tinted (not black) shadows, flat colours, simple readable shapes, no texture noise, no gradients. Stylized chunky proportions: slightly oversized hands and feet, broad shoulders, about seven heads tall. Plain flat light-grey background, no ground shadow, no props, nothing held in the hands, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark. Full-body FRONT VIEW, orthographic, like a 3D modelling reference: the character stands in a neutral A-pose, arms straight and angled about 40 degrees down from horizontal, away from the body, hands open and relaxed, feet shoulder-width apart with toes forward, facing the viewer squarely, symmetrical, centered, the whole body from the top of the head to the soles in frame with a margin. The character is a Street Punk: a late-1980s street-gang grunt, the most common enemy in the game, cocky and scrappy. The face must read at one metre and stay simple: it is partly covered or simplified (sunglasses, a bandana, a cap pulled low). Colour palette strictly limited to five flat colours: TEAL is the main colour, YELLOW the accent, plus dark charcoal, off-white, and skin. Absolutely no red or pink anywhere (red is reserved for blood in this game). Outfit: a yellow baseball cap pulled low over mirrored wraparound sunglasses, short spiky hair showing at the sides; a teal sleeveless denim vest with frayed armholes over a charcoal tank top; a studded charcoal belt; ripped pale teal-grey jeans; chunky off-white high-top sneakers with yellow laces; charcoal fingerless gloves; a strip of off-white tape round one forearm.

The character is the HERO, the player character, a lone late-1980s street brawler. In the game the player sees their own forearms, hands, legs and shoes in first person all the time, so those parts carry the most detail. Colour palette strictly limited to five or six flat colours from navy, grey, off-white, black, tan and skin. Absolutely no red or pink anywhere. Layout: a character design sheet, landscape. On the left half, the full body FRONT VIEW, orthographic, in a neutral A-pose (arms straight, angled about 40 degrees down from horizontal, away from the body, hands open; feet shoulder-width apart, toes forward), symmetrical, head to soles in frame; keep the face simple. On the right half, three large close-up detail callouts, cleanly separated: (1) the right forearm and open hand seen from the back of the hand, showing the hand wraps and the fingerless glove clearly; (2) the same right hand clenched into a fist, seen from the front, knuckles toward the viewer; (3) the right lower leg and shoe seen from the side. Outfit: off-white cloth hand wraps over the knuckles and round the wrists, under short black fingerless leather gloves with a wrist strap; bare forearms with a band of athletic tape; a navy T-shirt with the sleeves rolled; grey cargo trousers; white high-top sneakers with navy panels and thick soles.
